title: Reinforced Barrier (General, level 70)
body:
Syntax: perform reinforced barrier

Upgrade to the level-35 Barrier. Unlocks at level 70 for every class (practice once first). Cast a layered defensive field for up to 240 seconds before duration scaling, reducing all incoming damage by 35%. The field is bound to your present room and breaks immediately when you leave by walking, teleporting, recalling or being transferred.

Costs 65 Chakra before level scaling; cooldown 18 seconds. Recasting a Barrier tier replaces any weaker/equal room-bound Barrier. The tiers do not stack, nor do they multiply with personal Sanctuary or Elemental Shield. A weaker tier cannot replace an active stronger one. See HELP BARRIER and HELP FORTRESS BARRIER.
